install.step1.title: Prepare your computer
install.step1.body: Install the Node.js and Git versions listed for this release.
install.step1.check: Check that `node --version` and `git --version` print the listed versions.
install.step2.title: Install and start
install.step2.body: Run the command below in a terminal.
install.step2.check: Open the address shown in the terminal and check that the GeoAIDesk workspace appears.
install.step3.title: Connect your model
install.step3.body: In Settings, set the connection method, model and context length.
install.step3.check: Check that the model status shows Connected.
install.step3.notice: With an external model, your requests and parts of the files used in the analysis are sent to the model provider.
install.step4.title: Open the example
install.step4.body: Open an example project, inspect the source data, then run the analysis.
install.step4.check: Check that a new run appears in the run records.
install.step5.title: Check the output files
install.step5.body: Open the output files that the analysis wrote to the results folder.
